units.source_text: 仁太郎死了之后的这八年多，全家老小的生计都靠着阿民一个女人独自支撑。

en.t: For more than eight years after Nitaro died, the livelihood of the whole family, young and old, had been supported by Amin alone.

units.source_text: 与此同时，阿民在不知不觉中形成了好形象，声名远播，就连村子外的人都知道。

en.t: At the same time, Amin had unknowingly built a good image, and her reputation spread so far that even people outside the village knew of her.

units.source_text: 阿民不仅仅只是一个日夜操劳“赚钱”的年轻寡妇了，更不是村子里年轻男人口里的“年轻阿婶”。

en.t: Amin was no longer merely a young widow who worked day and night to earn money, much less the young auntie spoken of by the young men in the village.

units.source_text: 现在，她是模范媳妇，也是当今贞女的模范。

en.t: Now she was a model daughter-in-law and also a model of chastity for the present age.

units.source_text: ——“瞅瞅人家河对岸的阿民。”——这句话几乎成了很多人斥责别人的口头禅。

en.t: Look at Amin over on the other side of the river, people would say, and that line had almost become a stock phrase for scolding others.

units.source_text: 但是，阿住没有把自己心里的苦衷告诉邻居家的阿婆，也不打算把自己的委屈告诉任何人。

en.t: But Osumi did not tell the old woman next door about the suffering in her heart, nor did she intend to tell anyone of her grievances.

units.source_text: 虽然她自己心里并不明白，却仍坚信冥冥之中自有天理。

en.t: Though she herself did not really understand it, she still firmly believed that somewhere unseen there was a heavenly justice.

units.source_text: 但是最后连这一点救赎也泡汤了。

en.t: But in the end even that small bit of salvation came to nothing.

units.source_text: 现在，她唯一的依靠只剩下孙子广次了，其他什么都没了。

en.t: Now the only support she had left was her grandson Hiroji, and there was nothing else at all.

units.source_text: 不过意想不到的是，就连这最后唯一的依靠，也要濒临失去的风险了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, even this last and only support was now on the verge of being lost.
